name: Verata
tagline: The definitive standard of truth for the world's finest secondary market.
positioning: Verata is the authentication infrastructure behind luxury resale — a unified verdict engine that authenticates handbags, watches, and rare sneakers at marketplace scale, with an immutable provenance record for every item.

hero.h1: Every authentic. Every counterfeit. One verdict engine.
hero.sub: Verata turns weeks of expert backlog into a signed verdict in minutes. Photograph an item, and our authentication network returns a defensible determination plus a permanent provenance record your buyers can trust.

features.title: Verdict in minutes, not weeks
features.description: Route intake photos of a Birkin, a Daytona, or a Travis Scott pair through our model-plus-expert pipeline and receive a scored determination with confidence bands before the item leaves the intake table.

features.title: Immutable provenance ledger
features.description: Each authenticated item earns a tamper-evident record — origin, prior verdicts, ownership handoffs — so your resale listings carry proof, not promises.

features.title: Return fraud, sealed off
features.description: Match a returned item against its outbound serial and micro-imagery to catch the swap-and-return schemes that quietly erode luxury margins.

features.title: Consignment intake at scale
features.description: Give your intake associates a single console for triage, escalation, and batch verdicts across thousands of daily submissions.

features.title: Authenticator network on call
features.description: Overflow to Verata's vetted category specialists — watches, leather goods, jewelry — with SLA-backed turnaround during peak drops.

features.title: Audit-ready reporting
features.description: Export defensible verdict trails for chargeback disputes, insurers, and regulators with the evidence and reviewer attribution attached.

testimonials.quote: Verata cut our watch authentication backlog from eleven days to under two hours. The provenance record alone reduced our post-sale disputes by nearly half in one quarter.
testimonials.name: Camille Rousseau

testimonials.quote: We process forty thousand handbags a month. Verata's verdict engine is the only system that scaled with us without diluting the standard our clients expect.
testimonials.name: Devon Aldridge

testimonials.quote: The return-fraud matching paid for the entire contract in six weeks. It caught swaps our best authenticators were missing under peak-season pressure.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
